blurb: Joan and Jerry Hawk have been passionate collectors of fine art for 39 years, and for 14 years have been sharing that collection with the world. Bedford Fine Art Gallery was built on decades of hands-on expertise and a reputation for honesty. Museum directors say so. Certified appraisers say so.
